text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C after gains, but that doesn't show I timed either sale well; I should judge each trade by what I expect from here, not by whether it locks in a gain.","My reluctance to admit a losing purchase can keep me holding too long. Average cost is a reference point, not a reason to hold or sell.","A few months of account-value changes and past price moves don't predict next month's prices. I should avoid reacting to short-term noise and trade only for a clear reason."]}
